teaser.en: Carpenters can pick out its planks by smell alone, and the Digo call it the 'elephant' of its kind.
teaser.sw: Maseremala wanaweza kuzitambua mbao zake kwa harufu peke yake, na Wadigo huuita 'ndovu' wa aina yake.
teaser.dg: Mafundi a mbao anaweza kumanya mbaoze kpwa arufu tu, na Adigo anauiha 'ndzovu' kahi ya mihi ya *mtsani*.

summary.en: *Mtsani ndzovu*, the large-leaved false-thorn, is a spreading tree of the wooded grassland of the southern Kenya coast. *Mtsani* is one of the main local carpentry woods, and this is its big, durable kind.
summary.sw: *Mtsani ndzovu*, au *mchani ndovu*, ni mti uliotanda wa nyika zenye miti za pwani ya kusini mwa Kenya. *Mtsani* ni mojawapo ya mbao kuu za useremala katika eneo hili, na huu ndio aina yake kubwa na inayodumu.
summary.dg: *Mtsani ndzovu* (kpwa Chingereza *large-leaved false-thorn*) ni muhi unaotandazika wa nyasini zenye mihi pwani ya kusini ya Kenya. *Mtsani* ni kahi ya mbao muhimu za mafundi a hipha, na uhu ni ainaye kulu inayokaa muda mre.

about.en: *Mtsani ndzovu* is a deciduous tree with a spreading crown. Its leaves are large and twice divided, with broad leaflets, much bigger than those of most acacia-like trees. The flowers are cream powder-puffs, and the pods are flat.
about.sw: *Mtsani ndzovu* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye kilele kilichotanda. Majani yake ni makubwa na yamegawanyika mara mbili, yakiwa na vijani vipana, vikubwa zaidi kuliko vya miti mingi inayofanana na mikakaya. Maua ni vishada vya rangi ya krimu vinavyofanana na vifuta-poda, na maganda ni bapa.
about.dg: *Mtsani ndzovu* ni muhi ambao makodzage ganagbwa kpwa muda, wenye dari inayotandazika. Makodzage ni makulu na ganaganywa mara mbiri, genye makodza madide mapana, makulu sana kuriko ga mihi minji ya *acacia*. Maruwa ni mafungu ga nyuzi ga rangi ya maziya, na makakaya ni mapana na membamba.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland of the southern Kenya coast.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika zenye miti za pwani ya kusini mwa Kenya.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye nyasini zenye mihi pwani ya kusini ya Kenya.

uses.en: *Mtsani* is one of the main local carpentry woods, and this species gives durable sawn timber. People who work with the timber identify its planks by their strong smell.
uses.sw: *Mtsani* ni mojawapo ya mbao kuu za useremala katika eneo hili, na spishi hii hutoa mbao za kupasua zinazodumu. Watu wanaofanya kazi na mbao hizi huzitambua mbao zake kwa harufu yake kali.
uses.dg: *Mtsani* ni kahi ya mbao muhimu za mafundi a hipha, na aina hino inalavya mbao zinazokaa muda mre. Atu anaohenda kazi na mbao hizi nkumanya mbaoze kpwa arufuye kali.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtsani ndzovu*, 'elephant *mtsani*', the large one, as against *mtsani tsiye*, the small one. It is shared with Duruma and Giriama. The ICRAF handbook gives *mtsani ndovu* and *mchani ndovu* for Swahili and Digo. The Mgombato dictionary lists *mtsani* for this species, with many Swahili names: *mkarati*, *mtututu*, *mkarakala*, *mhina mwitu*, *mwiza* and *mnembenembe*. In English it is the large-leaved false-thorn.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtsani ndzovu*, yaani '*mtsani* ndovu', aina kubwa, tofauti na *mtsani tsiye*, aina ndogo. Jina hili linatumiwa pia na Waduruma na Wagiriama. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mtsani ndovu* na *mchani ndovu* kwa Kiswahili na Kidigo. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaorodhesha *mtsani* kwa spishi hii, pamoja na majina mengi ya Kiswahili: *mkarati*, *mtututu*, *mkarakala*, *mhina mwitu*, *mwiza* na *mnembenembe*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *large-leaved false-thorn*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtsani ndzovu*, '*mtsani* wa ndzovu', ambao ni mkulu, tafwauti na *mtsani tsiye*, ambao ni mdide. Dzina hiri piya ni ra Chiduruma na Chigiryama. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha *mtsani ndovu* na *mchani ndovu* kpwa Chiswahili na Chidigo. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *mtsani* kpwa aina hino, na madzina manji ga Chiswahili: *mkarati*, *mtututu*, *mkarakala*, *mhina mwitu*, *mwiza* na *mnembenembe*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *large-leaved false-thorn*.

reason.en: Another timber known by the smell of its planks
reason.sw: Mbao nyingine zinazotambulika kwa harufu ya mbao zake
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina ambao mbaoze nkumanyikana kpwa arufu
Muhi wanjina wa mbao unaomendzwa ni mafundi
